text:
Jorge (Marketing): odd spike this morning in the dashboard for launch traffic. numbers don't match the ad console. quick sync?
Maya (Marketing): could be duplication from the redirect bounce loophole. Priya, can you sanity-check sessions vs unique_visitors?
Priya (Analytics): quick check: session_count = 26,412; unique_visitors = 24,178. spike due to crawler hitting /signup? filtering in progress. link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/launch-traffic-debug
Lena (Growth): gating question: what metric do we use for the launch recap? sessions->signups or unique visitors->signups?
Jorge (Marketing): recommend unique_visitors->signups. less noisy and aligns to business view.
Sam (Sales Ops): sales prefers signups->qualified pipeline numbers. pipeline impact we report 30-day signups -> SQLs.
Priya (Analytics): updated dashboard: added unique_visitors->signup conversion and a small note about bot-filtering. also added 7d/30d split.
Maya (Marketing): thanks. next: attribution. Priya, what's top utm_source when we use 30-day?
Priya (Analytics): top sources: webinar-email (112), organic (87), linkedin-paid (64), partners (42). note: 'unknown' bucket is 56 due to redirect losses.
Jorge (Marketing): anyone object to headline: "30-day post-launch signups up 45% (n=412), driven by webinar cohort"?
Lena (Growth): fine but call out organic vs paid split in sub-bullet.
Sam (Sales Ops): please include raw sample sizes and % to avoid misinterpretation.
dash-bot: Weekly KPI snapshot scheduled for Mon 08:30 PST.
Maya (Marketing): actionables: Priya add sub-bullet with source split, Sam file redirect ticket, Jorge draft exec slide with 30-day headline and appendix with 7-day. reconvene Tues 11am.
